title: Concept: Lockfile resolves a bare tarball URL
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry pointing straight at a `.tgz` file rather than a registry path, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The tarball is not served through the registry API, so its metadata, signatures and advisory linkage do not exist for that entry.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The tarball is not served through the registry API, so its metadata, signatures and advisory linkage do not exist for that entry.
